message: Hi, I'm a student with a hadoop certification background. My overall academic average is 80.3% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and testing. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 1200 per year. I live in Delhi. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program is recommended because it offers the highest placement rate (78%) and a strong median starting salary of $10021 USD, directly addressing your priority for job security. While focused on data analytics rather than web development or testing, big data skills are highly relevant to IoT applications and modern software roles. The annual tuition of $800 USD fits well within your family's budget constraint of $1200 per year.

This program is the most direct match for your stated interest in 'testing,' as it focuses on Software Quality Engineering. The low annual tuition of $650 USD is excellent for your budget constraint. While its placement rate (60%) and salary ($7369) are lower than other options, mastering QA testing skills is a critical component of becoming a professional Web Developer.

MSc Cloud Computing provides foundational knowledge essential for both IoT and modern web development infrastructure. The annual tuition of $950 USD respects your strict budget limit. Although its placement rate (59%) is moderate, cloud skills are highly transferable to the tech industry, offering a strong technical pathway that aligns with your background in IT/Computer Science.
